subject: planner: check DROP privilege for TRUNCATE PARTITION statement (#64024) (#64225)
summary: Planner-only change: `PlanBuilder.buildDDL` now treats `ast.AlterTableTruncatePartition` the same as `ast.AlterTableDropPartition` by appending a `mysql.DropPriv` visitInfo (in addition to the existing `mysql.AlterPriv` for all `ALTER TABLE`). Privilege enforcement flows through `core.CheckPrivilege` → `pm.RequestVerification`, and table schema is already defaulted during preprocessing (`handleTableName`), so the added DROP check is applied to unqualified `ALTER TABLE t TRUNCATE PARTITION ...` as intended.
